tidbit: Did you know… one story this hour was carried by three different outlets in the last few hours.
transcript:
Hourly brief, Founders' Preview. Here is what is moving in superintelligence (SI), the next generation of artificial intelligence (AI).
NVIDIA released the RTX Spark laptop, a new device reported by GameMeca designed for running artificial intelligence agents locally on your hardware.
Arizona and 7 other states are suing OpenAI, reported by Your Valley, claiming the company's chatbot is hurting children and deceiving adults.
Omni-53 now opens credit union intelligence to ChatGPT, Claude and Copilot through MCP, reported by EIN Presswire, integrating credit union data with these assistants.
NVIDIA App version 11.0.9.565 adds an MCP server reported by GameGPU, letting artificial intelligence assistants control GPU settings on your device.
Physical artificial intelligence extends far beyond robots, says an NVIDIA veteran now investing in the space, reported by TechCrunch.
Free every hour.
